name: code-block
title: Code Block
description: shadcn/ui's base-nova code-block, fixed: the copy button takes labels for its name and its announcement, for other languages, says copied only while the value is the one copied, and says it could not copy when the clipboard refuses or the page has none (plain http, not a secure context) instead of throwing, output that streams in costs its new lines, not every line, to render and lay out (numbered too: blocks with the numbers in a gutter, not a grid of every line), a removed line's tint leaves coloured code (GitHub's red keywords) at 4.5:1, a diff is in greys (added lines a light grey with their +, removed ones struck through in the faintest grey on no tint, with their −), a line takes its own `number` (a diff's line in its file), code is 12px on 20px lines (an interface at 13px reads it so, not at the prose's 14px) and highlighted lines and pressed toggles show on the dark surface, the block has a hairline border and a card's corners, its header is a 36px bar over a divider with the title in grey mono, line numbers are a step lighter, in a gutter at least `--code-block-gutter-min` wide (24px by default), the copy button floating over the code is raised by shadow-float, the destructive block (failed output) is told in greys by weight, its text and title heavier, not red, the header's buttons and toggles are one size, the content fades at the edges it scrolls past, down as well as sideways, and is translate="no", so a page translator leaves code and output as written. With `lines`, a block longer than that folds in its own card: those lines whole (a wrapped line counts each it takes, a diff's @@ lines are not counted), its last two fading out, and a bar across its foot inside its border, "Show all · 30 lines", that shows the rest; open, the bar folds it again, and its header sticks to the top of what scrolls with a button that folds it, the block's start kept in view. Its words are `labels` (more, less, lines, collapse); `open`, `defaultOpen` and `onOpenChange` control it. Lines are measured after layout by one ResizeObserver, only those up to the fold, so output streaming in stays cheap; focus or find in the page reaching the folded part opens it; copying copies it all. The lines past the fold can be one plain text (CodeBlockRest; CodeBlockContent's own text does it), hidden until found, so a folded block of thousands of lines costs the dozen it shows and find in the page still opens it; open, they become lines 250 at a time as they near the view, each where its text was, the text laid out only near the view (useCodeBlockCut and cutLines for the app's own lines). The block clips rather than hides its overflow, so the header can stick. Its spacing on the 4px module (docs/grid.md).
